title: Constructible exceptional Frobenius mate, lifted adjunction and comparisons
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, $a\ge1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and $\Lambda\in\{E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$ put $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$, $g_T=\operatorname{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{Frob}_q)$ with geometric Frobenius, and $P_T=Lg_T^*$ [def-weil-frobenius-detailed, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Use the rational/common-stage bounded constructible categories and Weil pairs $(K,\theta_K:P_TK\xrightarrow{\sim}K)$, whose arrows satisfy $u\theta_K=\theta_LP_T(u)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k_0$-schemes, and put $f=f_0\times_{k_0}k:X\to Y$. Use the constructible adjunction $F=Rf_!\dashv G=Rf^!$ on $D^b_c$, with unit $\eta$ and counit $\varepsilon$, for every such $f$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Put $S=P_X$, $T=P_Y$, and assume their exact equivalences with inverse Frobenius transport and the canonical compact-support exchange isomorphism $a:TF\simeq FS$ of [def-exchange-projection], including its rational/common-stage construction. Give $F$ its Weil structure $F(\theta_K)a_K$. Then the adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]
$$ b:SG\xrightarrow{\eta SG}GFSG\xrightarrow{Ga^{-1}G}GTFG\xrightarrow{GT\varepsilon}GT $$
is an isomorphism, and $(L,\theta_L)\mapsto(GL,G(\theta_L)b_L)$, with arrow $G(u)$, defines a Weil lift of this same constructible $G$. Its unit and counit are Weil morphisms and satisfy the adjunction triangle identities after forgetting. More explicitly the mate obeys
$$ (Ga)(bF)(S\eta)=\eta S,\qquad (\varepsilon T)(Fb)(aG)=T\varepsilon, $$
and the induced structures obey
$$ \theta_{GFK}S(\eta_K)=\eta_K\theta_K,\qquad \varepsilon_L\theta_{FGL}=\theta_LT(\varepsilon_L). $$

On their stated constructible domains, use the standard Frobenius lifts of pullback, direct images, tensor and internal Hom, and the canonical comparisons of [def-exchange-projection]. Composition comparisons, exchange transformations, tensor evaluation, ordinary adjunction maps and the projection transformation are Weil morphisms. Composition, whiskering by these lifted functors and inversion of isomorphisms preserve the Weil-morphism equations. The unit–map–counit mate of any such comparison under the lifted exceptional adjunction is again equivariant; the mate-pasting identities identify these maps with the specified exceptional composition/exchange maps. Thus every such comparison already known to be invertible is an isomorphism of Weil pairs on exactly its proved domain. In the Frobenius square $a=\operatorname{Ex}_!$ is invertible also when the base is non-separated, after rationalization and in the common-stage category. No ambient exceptional right adjoint or separatedness of $X_0,Y_0$ is assumed. Equivariance alone makes no new comparison invertible.
